incident.name: Stream Finance xUSD collapse
incident.summary: Stream Finance disclosed a ~$93M loss by an external fund manager (Nov 4 2025); xUSD fell from ~$1.26 to ~$0.25 on secondary markets while the Morpho Arbitrum xUSD/USDC market oracle kept pricing xUSD at ~$1.266.
